title: Textbooks Are All You Need II: phi-1.5 technical report
measurement_description: The paper measures the propensity of models to generate toxic content in response to prompts related to different demographic groups, including Jewish and Muslim people, using the ToxiGen dataset. A higher 'safety score' indicates a lower likelihood of producing toxic sentences.
findings: According to the safety scores from the ToxiGen benchmark (Figure 2), the phi-1.5 model and its variant phi-1.5-web show a lower propensity for generating toxic content related to Jewish and Muslim demographics compared to other tested models like Falcon-rw-7b, gpt2-xl, and opt-1.3b. The paper attributes this improvement to the use of 'textbook-like' synthetic data over traditional web data for training.
